lesson: Cumulative default inclusion-heavy synthetic compounds strongly (control +0.059 just from adding more). Small-scale inclusion (0.3-0.7x downscaling of large sources) is the real lever: best inclusion/worst-class AP50 (0.493) at ~no mAP50 cost — KEEP it; but prefer_small inclusion SOURCES and any_class scratch backgrounds are both big net losses (mAP50 -0.05/-0.06 vs control), so avoid them. Round 3: build on small-scale inclusion and try to recover the patches dip (-0.085 vs control) via a bit more patches allocation or default-scale patches, while confirming small-scale inclusion holds.
